stack.description: The MagicQ cue stack this list is written to (its number); missing = 1

cue.description: Cue number, e.g. 12.5 (the cues are played in number order)

id.description: The cue's id: stays when the cue is renumbered (MagicQ's cue id when imported); missing = a new cue

name.description: The console's cue name, when it differs from the text

fadeIn.description: Seconds levels that go up (and all other values) take; missing = 0 (s)

fadeOut.description: Seconds levels that go down take; missing = 0 (s)

delay.description: Seconds after the GO before the fades start (Kloarte's playback only, not exported to MagicQ); missing = 0 (s)

additionalProperties.description: A number (intensity %, degrees, ...), a slot or set name ("Stars"), a function and its value ("Shutter1Strobe 5"), an exact DMX value ("dmx 37", or after a readable value: "Stars (dmx 37)"), or a palette ("@Front")

heads.description: Per head number: the values this cue sets (intensity in %, GDTF attributes in their units, slot names, "@palette")

dmx.description: DMX values of addresses that belong to no head (address: value), as an imported show may have them
